objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, or translated.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document name composed from abbreviation, number per type, and title by default.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type included in the name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow or lifecycle status of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity starts.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid-from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed into template-based document content.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment used to grant reader authorization.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person assigned as author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Person assigned additional change rights without relevance in the release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person assigned to check the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person assigned to release the document.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person assigned for translation release processing.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked for documents of this type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period after which archived documents of this type are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating a new document.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created during editing, revision, reactivation, or release lifecycle processing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document version.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled dependent document added to a document and released, versioned, archived, or reactivated with the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment added to a document, released directly via properties, and not subject to the main release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document and managed without affecting document content or version history until scheduled.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document for workflow-supported validity extension processing.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created for a selected document to invalidate and archive the document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person who creates, edits, reviews, releases, translates, acknowledges, or otherwise participates in document processes.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Implemented role such as reader, author, checker, approver, or translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned for authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access, or administration.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document with users or user groups for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: Distribution type that informs assigned users or groups by e-mail on release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution type that requests acknowledgement from assigned users or groups on release.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data such as IT applications that can be linked with documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be linked with documents through database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be linked with documents through database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be linked with documents through database integration.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type or template.

evts.name: edit_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and control assignments in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document so it is converted to PDF and displayed on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations to a document.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via property switches.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an attachment with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process after document creation, maintenance, and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check the document and complete review tasks.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes the release task, causing the document to be released and published.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reject a review or release task, cancelling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Create a new document version after revision, content changes, attachment changes, scheduled change proposals, or reactivation.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a released or validated document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension before validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the document valid-until date.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, creating a new editing version.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare the document out of force, archive it, and revoke authorizations except archive group access.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after a document is declared out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, create a new version, restore maintained metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign users or user groups to a document's distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request acknowledgement from persons and users of assigned groups by e-mail upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the current document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release a translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Automatically or manually link documents with processes, organizational units, risks, master data, or other documents.
